summary: Iteration 5: Verified demo-login block removal, forced OPS browser title, and login flows for all 3 seed accounts. Backend 12/12 pytest passed. One frontend bug found: direct navigation to /login when logged out redirects to / instead of showing login form (useEffect ordering issue).

integration_issues.issue: Direct navigation to /login redirects to / and does NOT render the login form. Root cause: In App.js the sync effect (L590) runs on mount with default activeTab='home'; because pathname==='/login', it pushState to '/'. The subsequent mount-only effect (L598) then reads pathname==='/', so activeTab is never set to 'login'. Fix: put the pathname-init effect BEFORE the sync effect, gate sync with a hasMounted ref, or lazily initialize useState('home' | 'login') from window.location.pathname.

action_items: Fix /login URL sync: reorder useEffects in App.js (~L588-607). Either (a) lazily initialize `activeTab` from window.location.pathname in useState, or (b) add a `didMount` ref so the sync effect skips its first run, or (c) move the pathname->activeTab init effect above the sync effect and add `user` to its dependency array. Everything else in the review request is passing.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1920 lines — should be split (login screen, home, driver dashboard, admin panel, delivery, rentals into separate components).
Two useEffects (L590 and L598) both touch pathname/activeTab and create a race on mount that broke deep-linking to /login.
document.title is force-set every 1500ms via setInterval; acceptable given Emergent overlay may override, but a MutationObserver on <title> would be cheaper than a polling interval.

rca of the issue: Bug: GET /login shows home page instead of login form when logged out. Reproduction: (1) clear cookies + localStorage, (2) visit https://iske-website.preview.emergentagent.com/login, (3) observe URL is rewritten to / and homepage renders. RCA: React runs effects in declaration order after first render. The sync effect at App.js L590 (deps=[activeTab]) fires on mount seeing activeTab='home' (default) and pathname='/login'; it pushState('/'). Immediately after, the mount-only effect at L598 checks pathname — now '/' — so it never sets activeTab='login'. Mitigation: lazy initializer -> `useState(() => window.location.pathname === '/login' ? 'login' : 'home')`, OR add a didMountRef guard to the sync effect so it skips first run.
